verses.1: Let it be a time for celebration, not a time for lamentation.
verses.2: We praise you, O God! We praise and honor your name. Your praises are countless.
verses.3: For when I take a meeting, I will surely remove them from their positions.
verses.4: I will destroy the land and all its inhabitants. I will make it a desolate place.
verses.5: I said to the blasphemers, “Do not blaspheme.” And to the wicked, “Do not raise your heads.”
verses.6: Do not raise your voices to the heavens; speak in a humble manner.
verses.7: For it does not come from the mountains, nor from the seas.
verses.8: For God who judges this will humble it, and he who punishes will destroy it.
verses.9: For she is in the hand of the LORD; her breasts are full of bitterness. She will be destroyed by him. But her children will be saved from all the wickedness of the earth.
verses.10: And I will forever sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.11: And all the horns of the wicked will be broken, and their horns will become useful for the righteous.
